conditions: Year-long central-member runs with heat flux (28 C and OISST boundary) and base run; monthly means
observable: Monthly age anomaly (heat minus base) against monthly bay-mean minus boundary temperature (or density)
expected_if_focal: Anomaly grows as the bay becomes colder than the boundary and is zero or negative when the bay is warmer
expected_if_rivals: H1b: anomaly follows surface buoyancy loss whatever the bay-sea contrast; H4: anomaly follows the boundary temperature error not the bay-sea contrast
falsifier: Positive anomalies in months when the bay is warmer than the boundary, or no relation between anomaly and bay-sea contrast in either run
indeterminate_result: Fewer than about 8 months with a clear contrast, or temperature not recoverable from the outputs
boundary_conditions: Central member only; 2016; bulk model physics of SCHISM
uncertainty: 24 monthly points with autocorrelation; report rank correlation and the sign pattern, not a p-value alone

conditions: 2x2 factorial over 2016: heat flux on/off by real/climatological wind; reading fixed before the runs
observable: Seasonal mean bay age in each of the four runs
expected_if_focal: Heat-flux effect in winter persists with climatological wind (at least half of its size with real wind)
expected_if_rivals: H3: winter heat-flux effect collapses when wind variability is removed
falsifier: Winter heat-flux effect with climatological wind is less than a quarter of the effect with real wind
indeterminate_result: Effect between a quarter and a half of the real-wind effect
boundary_conditions: One year; central member; climatological wind removes events but keeps the seasonal mean
uncertainty: Single realisation per cell; interaction term read descriptively

conditions: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level 2 surface temperature; clear scenes 2016-2025; bay vs adjacent sea polygons
observable: Bay minus sea surface temperature by season
expected_if_focal: Bay colder than the sea in December-March and warmer in June-September
expected_if_rivals: H0: no systematic seasonal sign change in the bay-sea contrast
falsifier: Bay warmer than sea in winter or no seasonal sign change beyond scene-to-scene spread
indeterminate_result: Too few clear winter scenes or contrast within retrieval uncertainty (about 1 K)
boundary_conditions: Skin temperature only; adjacency near shores; daytime overpass
uncertainty: Satellite skin temperature differs from bulk temperature; compare contrasts not absolute values

conditions: Year-long OISST heat-flux run re-run storing T and S profiles in the channel
observable: Surface-bottom density difference and age difference in the channel through the year
expected_if_focal: In winter the horizontal bay-sea density contrast reverses sign and bottom water in the channel becomes older than surface water at times
expected_if_rivals: H1b: channel becomes vertically mixed (density difference near zero) without a reversal of the horizontal contrast
falsifier: Vertical mixing without horizontal reversal in every winter episode
indeterminate_result: Both signatures present or neither resolved at 4-hourly output
uncertainty: Episodes are few; describe each instead of averaging

conditions: 64 members of block A with and without heat flux (exploratory: pattern seen in Fig. 6b before this plan)
observable: Paired age shift against the river discharge factor
expected_if_focal: Shift decreases as discharge increases (negative rank correlation)
falsifier: Rank correlation near zero or positive
indeterminate_result: Correlation weak with wide bootstrap interval
boundary_conditions: January-April 2016 only; exploratory because seen beforehand
uncertainty: Already observed qualitatively; confirmatory only with new members (e.g. X4 or block B with heat flux)
